events.title: Encode supplementary characters in reserved URI template expansion
events.excerpt: Fixes #1913 Reserved (`{+var}`) and fragment (`{#var}`) expansion in `UriTemplate.Encode` built a `Rune` from each UTF-16 `char`. For a surrogate pair (for example, an emoji), that throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`. On netstandard2.0 it didn't throw, but each half was encoded as U+FFFD. The encoder now encodes the full pair as one UTF-8 scalar. **Tests:** added `ReservedExpansion_EncodesSupplementaryUnicodeScalar`
